statement: Attach one or more DWG files as external references, choosing attachment or overlay type, full/relative/no path, scale, rotation, insertion point and optional geographic positioning, and manage them in the External References palette.

acceptance.sketch: Attach A.dwg relative path; edit A and RELOAD updates; Overlay xref not shown when attached into another.

notes: Verified against help page "XATTACH (Command)". Corrected: XREF only opens the External References palette (-XREF gives the prompt options); Reference Manager is a separate standalone tool (see row 12). Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-7DD70C3C-B8AD-40F1-8A69-5D1EECEAB013 ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-53030EDD-1D1D-40C4-922E-9B964A048ED9 ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-70599862-DF52-4291-B64B-8A4C45599F39 ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-7947385D-1A5D-4474-9AB9-FD5E46ADEF53 | prior app hint: cand2 app registers Insert; behavior and option coverage not verified against this row.

statement: Clip an xref or block reference with a rectangular, polygonal or polyline boundary, with front/back clip depth, invert clip, on/off and delete options, and frame visibility controlled by XCLIPFRAME.

acceptance.sketch: Clip with rectangle shows only inside geometry; XBIND Bind renames layers to xref$0$layer; Insert merges.

notes: Verified against help page "XCLIP (Command)". Corrected: Also covers XATTACH and XBIND; add separate rows. XBIND merges selected xref-dependent definitions (blocks, layers, styles) and the Bind/Insert choices belong to the XREF Bind option, not to XBIND. Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-D4B26149-C3A2-4547-A532-FF7A0D1CB2C9 ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-E3039A04-4524-462B-AA27-E5F7DE8C4E9E ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-DA921BBF-A545-4144-A63D-D866772C3759 | prior app hint: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry.

statement: Let users view and edit each xref's saved path, convert it between full, relative and no path, and resolve no-path references via the host folder, PROJECTNAME search paths and support paths.

source.ref: About Setting Paths to Referenced Drawings

superiority: Resolves missing files by project index.

acceptance.sketch: Relative path stays valid when both files are moved together; missing xref shows unresolved status.

notes: Verified against help page "About Setting Paths to Referenced Drawings". Corrected: XREFTYPE sets default attach vs overlay (not a path setting) and FILEDIA is unrelated; the default path type comes from REFPATHTYPE. Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-70599862-DF52-4291-B64B-8A4C45599F39 ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-CCC90130-7575-4901-8905-FBB4553DAA3F ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-BBE6FA4B-800E-4D7D-9D59-EDA24829C5E9 | prior app hint: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry.

statement: Show xref layers in the host as xrefname|layername and let users override their properties, with VISRETAIN deciding whether the overrides persist and VISRETAINMODE and XREFOVERRIDE refining sync and display behavior.

acceptance.sketch: Freezing A|WALL hides only that layer; VISRETAIN keeps across reloads.

notes: Verified against help page "About Xref Layer Property Overrides". Corrected: Kind changed from command to feature; naming convention is shown on the bind pages. Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-897B1672-4E09-42E0-B857-A9D1F96ED671 ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-131E3BBB-A28A-40BC-BDC5-A4486C1E2DBE | prior app hint: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry.

statement: Support xref demand loading controlled by XLOADCTL (off, locked original, or locked copy), unloading and reloading xrefs, and layer/spatial indexes saved via INDEXCTL.

source.ref: About Improving Performance When Using Xrefs

acceptance.sketch: XLOADCTL 2 uses a temporary copy so the source file stays editable.

notes: Verified against help page "About Improving Performance When Using Xrefs". Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-C89AD1A8-458B-4F51-B651-7C9A754EBF05 ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-78E98530-C455-43AA-8DB8-33EE3EAB85C4 ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-9D9A31DB-7256-4403-BD1C-4CD1FC314FAE | prior app hint: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry.

statement: Package selected drawings with their dependent xrefs, fonts and other referenced files into a folder or ZIP transmittal using saved transmittal setups, optionally converting to an earlier DWG format.

acceptance.sketch: ETRANSMIT of host with 2 xrefs yields zip with all files and a report listing them; paths remapped.

notes: Verified against help page "ETRANSMIT (Command)". Corrected: Autodesk removed self-extracting EXE packages and ZIP passwords from eTransmit. Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-0C34FD41-C06A-4CEE-B5C6-D783A1774062 ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-9A2F96E5-34D1-4504-A5F3-54BCD410041D | prior app hint: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry.

statement: Attach PDF, DGN (2D content only) and DWF/DWFx files as underlays with clipping, contrast, fade and monochrome adjustment, object snap to underlay geometry (UOSNAP) and layer display control.

acceptance.sketch: Attach PDF page 2 scaled 1:1; OSNAP snaps to PDF vector endpoints; clip rectangle works.

notes: Verified against help page "About Underlays". Corrected: Navisworks NWD/NWC files attach as coordination models and raster images attach via IMAGEATTACH, not as underlays; underlays cannot be bound. Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-7D42F81C-1007-4D3C-83CE-88D2AF49918E ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-4D95FB38-58B7-4F32-9F29-FC7EA49EB4E2 ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-AB149F54-6DB8-4E51-8B10-F04C93B8EC66 | prior app hint: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry.

statement: Import PDF vector geometry, solid fills, TrueType text and raster images as editable objects, choosing layer assignment and join/hatch conversion options, and convert imported SHX-style geometry back to text with PDFSHXTEXT.

acceptance.sketch: PDF with line and text: lines become polylines, text becomes mtext; SHX recognition maps fonts.

notes: Verified against help page "PDFIMPORT (Command)". Corrected: SHX text is not recognized during import; it arrives as geometry and is converted by the separate PDFSHXTEXT command. Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-C61D24C2-411D-44A6-B93E-E4A07E47060E ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-1202CC8A-364F-4E93-8E86-6F476CD83C72 ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-A0F80ABD-0F1C-47FB-B7E3-E4C699DAEE83 | prior app hint: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry.

statement: Attach raster images with path type, insertion point, scale and rotation, clip them with IMAGECLIP, adjust brightness/contrast/fade with IMAGEADJUST, and control frame display and plotting with IMAGEFRAME.

acceptance.sketch: Image attached at 1 unit per pixel scale; clip rectangle crops; frame hidden when IMAGEFRAME=0.

notes: Verified against help page "IMAGEATTACH (Command)". Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-9D652E1A-29F8-49BC-ABCC-37B9F1C7A1D0 ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-FA5F80B3-1581-40DF-BFEA-E6383A9266CE ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-D736B7E4-92C8-41DF-899D-622DB58D09F3 ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-ED93554F-6006-4230-93FA-FBF6DCB00F28 | prior app hint: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry.

statement: Import MicroStation DGN V7/V8 files into the current or a new drawing using mapping setups for layers, text styles and linestyles, and export DWG content to V7 or V8 DGN with DGNEXPORT.

acceptance.sketch: Import V8 DGN: elements map to layers per DGNMAPPING; export yields DGN reopenable.

notes: Verified against help page "DGNIMPORT (Command)". Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-70E12630-4067-41E0-8D38-E165B5AD139E ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-2A82AA09-4C1A-4737-910A-064D872F12B5 ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-F884EE2E-1251-4ED9-843A-E5BD95AC9971 | prior app hint: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry.

statement: Attach ReCap RCS scan and RCP project files as point clouds with scale, rotation and insertion options, display density and stylization controls, and cropping.

acceptance.sketch: Attach 1M points: display density controls; crop region limits.

notes: Verified against help page "POINTCLOUDATTACH (Command)". Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-C0C610D0-9784-4E87-A857-F17F1F7FEEBE ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-8D698472-3435-4632-BEC8-301D417F760B | prior app hint: cand2 app registers PointCloud; behavior and option coverage not verified against this row.

statement: Provide a standalone reference manager that lists a drawing's dependencies with type, status, saved path and found path, lets users edit paths and load or unload underlays, and works across several drawings.

acceptance.sketch: Edit path of an xref via manager: drawing opens with the new path.

notes: Verified against help page "About Reference Manager and Underlays". Corrected: Page documents DWF/DWFx/PDF/DGN underlay paths and file dependencies; coverage of image, font and plot style references is not stated. Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-9367D6DD-0BD0-4F72-A417-675AABA128B4 | prior app hint: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry.

statement: Compare an attached xref against the latest saved state of its source file, or another drawing, and highlight changes with color inside revision clouds on an Xref Compare toolbar.

acceptance.sketch: Version diff shows added green and removed red layers.

notes: Verified against help page "XCOMPARE (Command)". Corrected: Comparison is against the current referenced file or a chosen drawing, not a stored previous version. Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-84E4CED9-A52E-4F36-8D30-EB660DDC1086 | prior app hint: cand2 app registers XrefCompare; behavior and option coverage not verified against this row.

statement: Compare two drawings, color common, added and removed objects, group differences in revision clouds, and allow importing differences and exporting a snapshot drawing.

acceptance.sketch: Moved line shows as removed in one color and added in another; count of changes reported.

notes: Verified against help page "COMPARE (Command)". Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-2D69E78D-5C82-464F-B864-CD29D5720EB9 | prior app hint: cand2 app registers DwgCompare; behavior and option coverage not verified against this row.

statement: Periodically check attached xrefs for changes (XREFNOTIFY, default every 5 minutes), notify the user through a status bar icon and balloon, and allow reloading changed xrefs.

acceptance.sketch: After saving referenced file, host balloon notes the change; reload updates.

notes: Verified against help page "About Updating Referenced Drawing Attachments". Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-D97BECAD-2380-4CA3-896C-A6896BE112F7 | prior app hint: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry.

statement: Attached xrefs nest inside any drawing that attaches their host, while overlaid xrefs are ignored when their host is itself attached or overlaid elsewhere.

source.ref: About Nesting and Overlaying Referenced Drawings

acceptance.sketch: Host H overlays B; attaching H into G shows no B; if B attached, B appears.

notes: Verified against help page "About Nesting and Overlaying Referenced Drawings". | prior app hint: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry.

statement: Detect circular xref chains: warn and let the user cancel when attaching, and break the cycle with an error message when loading a drawing.

source.ref: About Missing or Circular External References

acceptance.sketch: A attaches B attaches A: warning and stop at depth.

notes: Verified against help page "About Missing or Circular External References". | prior app hint: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry.

statement: Bind an xref into the host either with Bind (xref-dependent names become unique blockname$n$name) or Insert (names merge with local ones), and detach to remove an xref and its instances.

acceptance.sketch: Bind Insert merges layer WALL into host WALL; Bind renames to A$0$WALL.

notes: Verified against help page "Bind Xrefs/DGN Underlays Dialog Box". Corrected: Only the Bind option guarantees unique names; Insert strips the xref prefix and local definitions win on conflicts. Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-1BC15FC3-D900-4293-B210-BFC3B9C088BC ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-70599862-DF52-4291-B64B-8A4C45599F39 | prior app hint: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry.

statement: Dim DWG xref objects by the XDWGFADECTL percentage (up to 90, negative values store the setting while disabled); underlays have their own fade control.

acceptance.sketch: Fade 50 percent shows xref at half intensity.

notes: Verified against help page "XDWGFADECTL (System Variable)". Corrected: XDWGFADECTL applies to DWG xrefs only; underlay fading is a separate per-underlay setting. | prior app hint: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry.
